shellCommands.command: ls -la; git status 2>&1 | head; node -v; npm -v; ls ~/.npm 2>/dev/null | head -3
cat package.json .gitignore; ls node_modules; ls node_modules/.bin; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; find __agent_eval__ | head
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest 2>&1 | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json node_modules/react/package.json
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -B3 -A12 -i warn | head -40

npm run build >/tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?
mkdir -p data && cat > data/books.json <<'EOF'
[{"id":"abc-1","title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Line one\nLine two","status":"reading","addedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z","finishedAt":null},
 {"id":"abc-2","title":"Emma","author":"Jane Austen","notes":"","status":"finished","addedAt":"2026-08-01T00:00:00Z","finishedAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00Z"}]
EOF
for round in 1 2; do
 (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
 echo "--- round $round"
 curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Currently reading\|Finished<\|Dune\|Emma\|Mark finished' | sort | uniq -c
 curl -s localhost:3123/books/abc-1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|by Frank Herbert\|Line one\|Copy link'
 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing=%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/nope
 pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f next-server; sleep 1
done
rm -rf data

curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Currently reading\|Finished<\|Dune\|Emma\|Mark finished' | sort | uniq -c
curl -s localhost:3123/books/abc-1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|by Frank Herbert\|Line one\|Copy link'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing=%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/nope
ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i playwright; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null

curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Currently reading\|Finished<\|Dune\|Emma\|Mark finished' | sort | uniq -c; echo ---
curl -s localhost:3123/books/abc-1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|by Frank Herbert\|Line one\|Copy link'; echo ---
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing=%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/nope
